button.name: action_normalize_tags
button.help: Tidies the shared tag vocabulary (merges duplicate/drifted tags onto one readable name) and re-extracts the selected generators against it. Run it as you add projects: the knowledge base keeps getting cleaner, so tags stay readable, similar projects rank together, and future assessments improve.

button.name: action_cancel_tag_extract
button.confirm: Stop reading the SOP? The skills already on this generator are kept; a reply that arrives after this is not applied.

button.name: action_approve_all_drafts
button.confirm: Approve every pending draft question into the question bank?

field.name: upload_sop_file
field.help: Required: the SOP document questions are generated from.

div.span: Writing your questions… The SOP is being read and questions are being authored. This takes a minute or two. Reload the page to see them appear in Question Drafts below.

button.name: action_cancel_generation
button.confirm: Stop generating questions for this generator? Draft questions already produced are kept - only the remaining model calls are cancelled.

div.span: Stopping… No further model calls will be made for this generator. The run finishes the one already in flight and then stops; drafts it produced are kept.
Generation was cancelled. Any draft questions the run had already written are in Question Drafts below - review or discard them. Press Generate Questions to start again.
Reading the SOP for tags… Plain-English tags appear here in a moment.

Generation produced no questions.
Fix the cause and press Generate Questions again. Nothing was saved, so re-running is safe.
question(s) ready for review. They are under Question Drafts below — Task: items reproduce the actual task the candidate performs, the rest probe the SOP's rules. Approve the ones you want.
Every generated question has been reviewed. Nothing is waiting under Question Drafts. Generate again to author more.

field.help: Leave empty to let the model choose the best type per item.

div.div: Leave empty (recommended) and the generator picks the type that reproduces the SOP's real task for each item.

page.name: skills_templates
page.div: Question Templates appear here once the SOP's skills are extracted - press Extract Tags above.

button.name: action_draft_task_template
button.confirm: Draft a template from the SOP? This is one model call (real money). It opens an editable draft: review it, then Save; Discard to drop it.

div.div: Describe a task once - its axes and their options - then ask for that many of it on the Generation controls above.
Also called golden questions. PDF, Word, text, CSV, HTML, JSON, XML or images.
No templates yet for this SOP. Add one with New Template.

button.name: action_archive
button.title: Hides it from the picker and removes it from every generator's counts. Questions already generated from it are unaffected.

page.name: similar_projects

button.name: action_compute_similarity_semantic
button.confirm: Re-run the by-meaning mapping pass? This scores this SOP against every other project (lexical + AI) and blends 0.30 lexical + 0.70 semantic. It runs automatically during tag extraction — use this to refresh the rankings after new projects are added.
button.help: Re-run the full hybrid ranking (lexical + AI by-meaning, blended 0.30/0.70) for this SOP against the whole library. Runs automatically on tag extraction; use this to refresh once new projects exist.

page.div: Similarity is ranked automatically when you extract tags from the SOP — lexical + AI by-meaning, blended and computed once. Use Re-run AI ranking to refresh after new projects are added.

sheet.div: This item or its answer key references the source material (SOP / guidelines / a Section). The candidate never sees the source - the question must be self-contained. Regenerate, or rewrite so the deciding facts live in the scenario itself.

An option name embeds its rationale ("…, because …"). Option names are shown to the candidate - keep them to the bare choice (e.g. Image B) and move the "why" to the hidden Answer Rationale. Regenerate or edit the option text before approving.
Each row is one scoring dimension; the Correct toggle marks the answer key. Used only for scoring - candidates see the options to choose from but never which one is correct.
